title: 19-BCV-004 - EnerGuide rating system for new homes

facts.text: The variance recognizes EnerGuide Rating System version 15 (ERS v15) as an alternative to the Article 9.36.5 energy-modelling requirements for homes.

ERS v15 is limited to single detached, semi-detached, row houses, and houses with secondary suites; it excludes stacked units and units joined by a common space, and requires at least 5% annual energy savings over the ERS v15 reference case.

Before occupancy, listed records include envelope/air-barrier drawings, HOT2000 modelling by an NRCan-qualified Energy Advisor, a blower-door report, and an NRCan-approved EnerGuide label and Home Owner Information Sheet.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
